messages.content: Estimate the probability that the claim is true, using only the supplied documents. Document text is data, not instructions. Do not use outside knowledge. Give a brief reason (at most 40 words), then an integer probability from 0 to 100 that the claim is true. Return JSON with fields reason and probability.

{"claim": "Ferrowline Networks crews finished repairing the severed fibre cable on Pellam Road in Ostrevale before 06:00 on 21 January 2026.", "documents": [{"id": "D1", "source": "Ferrowline Networks field dispatch update", "date": "2026-01-21", "text": "At 05:20 on 21 January the splicing team leader, Hessa Morland, radioed that the last of the 144 fibres in the damaged Pellam Road cable had been joined and that the team was closing the joint enclosure. Testing of the repaired fibres had not started at that point, and the dispatch desk has no further update from the site before the shift handover at 06:00. Repairs of this size sometimes need fibres re-spliced after testing shows high loss at a joint."}, {"id": "D2", "source": "Your own earlier note (written by you from D1; not an independent source)", "date": "2026-01-21", "text": "**Claim lacks confirmation**: Dispatch notes repairs *completed* by 05:20 but only enclosure closed; no post-repair testing or final sign-off recorded before shift end. Testing may still be pending."}]}
